blocks.text: Real Russian sentences that use what the lesson teaches. Type the missing word, or pick it, until it turns green.

These are real sentences: from Tatoeba (tatoeba.org, CC BY 2.0 FR), with their English translations, and from the public-domain Russian books in this library, with author and title. Each blank is the word the sentence really has; the word in brackets is its dictionary form.

exercises.q: The children are fighting over a bar of chocolate.
exercises.ru: Дети дерутся ___ шоколадки.
exercises.why: «из-за — from behind; because of» (+ genitive); «благодаря + Dat. — thanks to». — DLI, Lessons 60, 103. Sentence and translation from Tatoeba (CC BY 2.0 FR).

exercises.q: Because I do sit-ups every day, you can finally see my six pack.
exercises.ru: ___ я каждый день качаю пресс, вы наконец-то можете видеть его рельеф.
exercises.why: Sentence and translation from Tatoeba (CC BY 2.0 FR).

exercises.q: Thank God I am an atheist.
exercises.ru: ___ богу я атеист.
exercises.why: «из-за — from behind; because of» (+ genitive); «благодаря + Dat. — thanks to». — DLI, Lessons 60, 103. Sentence and translation from Tatoeba (CC BY 2.0 FR).

exercises.q: She couldn't open the door because it was bolted from inside.
exercises.ru: Она не смогла открыть дверь, ___ та была заперта изнутри на задвижку.
exercises.why: Sentence and translation from Tatoeba (CC BY 2.0 FR).

exercises.q: I'm the one who got us into this mess.
exercises.ru: Это ___ меня мы попали в эту переделку.
exercises.why: «из-за — from behind; because of» (+ genitive); «благодаря + Dat. — thanks to». — DLI, Lessons 60, 103. Sentence and translation from Tatoeba (CC BY 2.0 FR).

exercises.q: If a sentence doesn't yet have audio, it's because nobody has recorded one for us.
exercises.ru: Если к предложению не прилагается аудио, это ___ его никто ещё для нас не записал.
exercises.why: Sentence and translation from Tatoeba (CC BY 2.0 FR).

exercises.q: Tires wear down because of friction between the rubber and the road surface.

exercises.q: As it was late at night and I was very tired, I put up at an inn.
exercises.ru: ___ была уже поздняя ночь, и я очень устал, я разместился в гостинице.
exercises.why: Sentence and translation from Tatoeba (CC BY 2.0 FR).

exercises.q: The British started to attack from across the river.

exercises.q: Tom tasted the popcorn and decided it wasn't salty enough, so he sprinkled on some more salt.
exercises.ru: Том попробовал попкорн и решил, что он недостаточно соленый, ___ он его подсолил.
exercises.why: Sentence and translation from Tatoeba (CC BY 2.0 FR).

exercises.q: Australia's Great Barrier Reef is threatened by climate change.
exercises.ru: Австралийский Большой Барьерный риф находится под угрозой ___ изменения климата.

exercises.q: I've locked myself out of my house, so I'm going to break a window to get in.
exercises.ru: Дверь моего дома заблокировалась изнутри, ___ я разобью окно, чтобы попасть внутрь.
exercises.why: Sentence and translation from Tatoeba (CC BY 2.0 FR).

exercises.q: It acquired the name "armadillo" thanks to the armor that covers its back.
exercises.ru: Своё название броненосец получил ___ броне, которая покрывает его спину.

exercises.q: The flashbang grenade got its name from the bright flash and loud bang it generates upon explosion.
exercises.ru: Светозвуковая граната так называется ___ при взрыве производит яркую вспышку и громкий звук.
exercises.why: Sentence and translation from Tatoeba (CC BY 2.0 FR).

exercises.q: Due to total Russification in Belarus, the Belarusian language is on the brink of extinction.

exercises.q: Every student trusts Mr Akai because he never breaks his word.
exercises.ru: Все студенты доверяют господину Акаи, ___ он никогда не нарушает своего слова.
